metadata.description: The Forge family: Compforge (frontend), OOPforge (backend), and FuseForge (full-stack coordinator).

plugins.name: compforge
plugins.description: TypeScript + React component architecture: component boundaries, state placement, and a staged workflow.

plugins.name: oopforge
plugins.description: Java Spring and Python FastAPI backends, plus experimental Kotlin Spring, with OOP/DDD modeling, layered or hexagonal architecture, and CQRS.

plugins.name: fuseforge
plugins.description: Experimental coordinator for one full-stack feature across Compforge and OOPforge.
